site.title: Nivha By Fashion Cut — Women's & Children's Boutique | Custom Tailoring, Palakkad
site.metaDescription: Custom tailoring, hand embroidery and the Punarnivha upcycling collection. Bridal blouses, lehengas, suits and more — stitched with care in Palakkad, Kerala.

header.tagline: Stitched with care, made for you

hero.heading: Style that's made
hero.description: From bridal blouses and lehengas to Aari embroidery and upcycled sarees — Nivha By Fashion Cut brings your vision to life with careful hands and an eye for detail.

craft.heading: Fashion that fits
craft.body: At Nivha By Fashion Cut, we believe every woman and child deserves clothes crafted around them — not the other way around. From the first measurement to the final stitch, every detail is handled with patience, skill, and genuine care for the person wearing it.

imageStrip.ariaLabel: Fabrics, threads and detailed hand embroidery work at Nivha By Fashion Cut

services.heading: A stitch for
services.subheading: Tell us what you need. We'll bring it to life — one careful stitch at a time.

items.title: Custom Tailoring
items.description: Bridal blouses, lehengas, suits, churidars, crop tops and skirts — stitched to your exact measurements and taste.

items.title: Embroidery
items.description: Hand work embroidery, machine embroidery and specialist Aari embroidery — delicate detailing that makes every piece memorable.

items.title: Punarnivha Collection
items.description: Our fabric revival service transforms old sarees — including Banarasi — and leftover fabrics into modern palazzo pants, jackets, crop top cholis and shrugs.

process.imageAriaLabel: The quiet, tactile work of the Nivha By Fashion Cut studio
process.heading: Simple as

steps.title: Share your idea
steps.description: Send us a reference, a garment, or just a feeling over WhatsApp. We'll listen carefully.

steps.title: We plan together
steps.description: We discuss fabric, fit, embroidery and every finishing detail to make sure it's exactly right.

steps.title: Crafted for you
steps.description: Your piece is carefully stitched, fitted and finished by hand — ready to wear and keep.

closing.heading: Shall we make
closing.body: Tell us what you're dreaming up. We'd love to hear about it.
closing.signoff: With care, Nivha By Fashion Cut
